page.layout: One page of text in a single column, Greek and Latin dictionary entries; a narrow column of small marginal notes cut off at the right edge (right margin, partly illegible, mostly unreadable fragments of Greek and Latin references).

main_text.p: Διλωενὴς ἐᾳ̃ ὁ ἡ. Διλωενὲς ἐᾳ̃ τὸ perpetuus a um, ex Δι᾽ ἐᾳ̃ Th. ἡνεκνὴς ἐᾳ̃ ὁ ἡ continuus, perpetuus. εἰς τὸ Διλωενὲς in perpetuum, Heb.7.3.
Διφάλαος ᾳ̃ ὁ ἡ bimaris, ἀ διφάλασα ης ἡ mare, Actor.27.41. τόπος διφάλασος, locus bimaris. h.e. qui utrimq; mari alluitur. unā voce vocatur isthmus, estq; terra angusta inter duo maria.
Διϊχνέομαι ἕμαι pertingo. (ex Δι᾽ ἐᾳ̃ ἰχνέομαι venio.) Fut. διξομαι. P. διγμαι. aor.2.med. διχόμην ᾳ̃ ἐᾳ̃. Part. διχνάμενος, Heb.4.12.
Διίστημι disto, interpono. Fut. Διᾶστήσω. P. Διέστηκα. aor.1. Διέστησα. part.a.1. Διαστήσας αυτος ὁ progressus Actor.27.28. a.2. διέστην ης ἡ disjunctus fui.
Διϊχνεΐζομαι affirmo, affevero. imperf.med. ἰχνεΐζομαι cum dat. nitor. ab ἰσχυρὸς robustus. Th.ἰσχὺς ὁ ἡ robur.
Διχαιοκρισία ας ἡ justum judicium. q.d. Διχαία κρίσις, Rom.2.5.
Δίκαιος αἰκα αιον justus a um, vere justus, 1.Joh. 3.7. ( Marc.2.17. innocens Matth.23.35. probus Matth.1.19. fincerus Luc.20.20. Th. Δίκη jus.
Διχαιόω ῶ justifico, h.e. justum pronuntio, pro justo habeo. praes. infin. Διχαιοῦν ἕν Luc.10. v.29. part. praes. Διχαιῶν ὢν, οὖν ἕν ὁ.

page.notes: Marginal notes on the right edge are cut off and too damaged to transcribe reliably. Several Greek words are uncertain and may be misread; the transcription of Greek is approximate.
